title: The note field's label and limit, and one part matches a bulk of one
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Read the note field label and try to type past 255 characters.
  2. Deactivate one part from its edit dialog and one via a bulk selection of one; compare permission, note field and the history entry written.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The note field is labelled "Note (optional)" and stops accepting input at 255 characters.
  • Deactivating a single part from the edit dialog takes the same permission, sends to the same endpoint, offers the same note field and writes the same history entry as a bulk change of one - only the title and opening line differ.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R24: “The note field is labelled "Note (optional)" and stops accepting input at 255 characters, so S10-R12 applies to requests that do not come from the dialog.”
  • S10-R25: “Deactivating a single part from the part edit dialog takes the same permission, sends to the same endpoint, offers the same note field and writes the same history entry as a bulk change of one. Only the title and the opening line differ, naming the part instead of a count, per S10-R20 and S10-R21.”
